title: Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs

result.label: Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs
result.statement: Proves termination of every existing generalized log canonical flip sequence on globally Weil ℚ-factorial compact Kähler fourfolds, with rational boundary, fixed rational analytically nef b-data, and projective small flip diagrams with the prescribed ample signs. Also proves termination of arbitrary permitted minimal model programs for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary in characteristic zero.
